channel.title: Startup on Jungbae Park
channel.description: Recent content in Startup on Jungbae Park

item.title: Emotional Text-to-Speech and Voice Conversion Systems
item.description: Led development of duration-controllable TTS and emotional voice conversion at Humelo, producing two ICASSP publications (2019 Oral 1st author, 2020). Won Minister of Science and ICT Special Award at K-Startup 2018.

item.title: Government & Public R&D Grant Management
item.description: Secured ~US$875K across three competitive Korean government R&D grants (IITP, TIPS, Seoul R&BD) at Humelo, covering brain-inspired AI, emotional TTS, and voice conversion research.

item.title: Polyphonic Sound Event Detection with Transfer Learning
item.description: Developed convolutional bidirectional LSTM with synthetic data-based transfer learning for polyphonic sound event detection at Humelo, achieving +28.4% F1 improvement. Published at ICASSP 2019 as corresponding author.

item.title: AI Music Composition and SM Entertainment Collaboration
item.description: Led AI music composition and rap synthesis at Humelo, presented at SXSW 2019, collaborated with SM Entertainment and rapper Sleepy (KBS Documentary), and received coverage from 10+ national media outlets.

item.title: Speech Emotion Recognition & Classification System
item.description: Built a multi-class speech emotion recognition system at Humelo using SpeechCNN and CRNN architectures with MFCC/Mel-spectrogram features, integrated into the Emotional TTS pipeline.
